narrationTexts: Confirms the bug: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Fixed. All 625 tests pass.**

`orderTotal` in [pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39) taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. Only 3 of 625 cases caught it, since most rows had a zero discount or zero tax.

Changed it to tax the discounted total:
```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
return roundCents(discounted * (1 + taxRate));
```

Next: nothing, suite is green.
